title: Verify: History error message and Retry button unit tests
summary: Unit tests for error alert and Retry presence
description: Add unit tests for the error state rendering with listMine mocked.
acceptance_criteria: Rejected listMine shows the alert text and Retry
technical_constraints: Mock ../src/api/client with vi.mock keeping actual exports

steps.action: Create jsdom test file mirroring tests/contributionHistoryRetry.test.tsx mocks. Test 'shows error and Retry': listMine.mockRejectedValueOnce(new Error('x')), render <ContributionSheet open onClose={vi.fn()} roundId="round-1" />, assert findByRole('alert') has text 'Could not load your suggestions' and getByRole('button',{name:'Retry'}) exists. Test 'hides both on success': mockResolvedValueOnce([]), wait for loading text to vanish, assert queryByRole('button',{name:'Retry'}) is null and the error text is absent. Fixture data comes from tests/fixtures/api.ts, which mirrors the listMine response type in src/api/client.ts.
